accountErrors.deleted: This account has been deleted. Ask your teacher.

accountErrors.noPlayer: There's no player with that name. Have the student sign up with that name first.
expected.Notes: a note such as Notes.C or "C#4", or a list of notes for a chord
expected.Direction: a direction: Up, Down, Right or Left
expected.value: a value (a number, text, a list or an object)
expected.amount: an amount: 0 or a positive number
errors.syntax: The computer didn't understand this line. Check the brackets, quotes and commas.
errors.syntaxString: This text never ends. You opened a quote (" or ') but didn't close it on the same line.
errors.syntaxTemplate: The text that starts with ` never ends.
errors.syntaxComment: The comment that starts with /* never ends. Put */ at its end.
errors.syntaxQuotes: The quote mark {char} doesn't work in code. Use plain quotes: " or '.
errors.syntaxArmenianPunct: The sign {char} is Armenian punctuation. In code, a line ends with ; (a semicolon).
errors.syntaxCharacter: You can't use the sign {char} here in code.
errors.syntaxPythonDef: In JavaScript, you make a function with the word function: function name() { … }
errors.syntaxPythonElif: JavaScript has no elif. Write: else if (…) { … }
errors.syntaxConditionParens: A condition goes inside parentheses. For example: while (true) { … } or if (isRipe()) { … }
errors.syntaxPythonColon: In JavaScript, you don't put : after if or while. Put the code inside curly braces: { … }
errors.syntaxReturnOutside: You can only write return inside a function.
errors.syntaxBreakOutside: You can only write break and continue inside a loop.
errors.syntaxAssignTarget: You can't give this a value with =. The left side must be a variable.
errors.syntaxKeyword: The word "{word}" has a special meaning in JavaScript, so you can't use it here.
errors.syntaxUnclosed: This bracket {char} was opened but never closed.
errors.syntaxUnexpectedCloser: This bracket {char} is extra: there's no opening bracket that matches it.
errors.syntaxMismatch: The bracket {open} was closed with the wrong bracket: {char}.
errors.syntaxUnexpected: The computer didn't expect "{token}" here. Maybe you missed a bracket, a comma or a semicolon.
errors.syntaxUnexpectedEnd: The code ended too early. Check that every bracket is closed.
errors.redeclare: The name "{name}" is already taken. Pick another name, or remove the word let / const.
errors.lockedSyntax: You haven't unlocked {featureName} yet. Research "{nodeName}" first.
errors.lockedFunction: The function {name}() isn't unlocked yet. Research "{nodeName}" first.
errors.noteLength: The second number in playNote() is how long the note lasts, in beats: from 0.125 to 8. You wrote: {gotText}. For example: playNote(Notes.C, 1)
errors.notePitch: Write a pitch in quotes, such as "C4", "C#4" or "Bb3" (A0 to C8). You wrote: {gotText}.
errors.noteChord: A chord needs a list of 1 to 8 notes. For example: playNote(["C4", "E4", "G4"], 1)
errors.noteTempo: The third number in playNote() is the tempo: 30 to 300 beats per minute (BPM). You wrote: {gotText}. For example: playNote(Notes.C, 1, 100)
errors.lockedFunctionVillage: The function {name}() isn't unlocked yet. Repair "{nodeName}" in the village (the "Village" button).
errors.lockedFunctionRanch: You don't have the command {name}() yet. Buy it in the ranch "Shop".
errors.unsupported: "{what}" doesn't work in this game. Try solving it another way.
errors.notDefined: There's no variable or function called "{name}".
errors.removedCommand: The command "{name}" isn't in the game anymore. Plants don't pick friends now, so just delete that line.
errors.assignUndeclared: The variable "{name}" hasn't been made yet. The first time, write: let {name} = …
errors.assignConst: The variable "{name}" was made with const, so it can't change. Use let instead.
errors.assignBuiltin: "{name}" is a game function. You can't change it.
errors.assignImport: "{name}" is imported from another file, so you can't change it here.
errors.constNoValue: A variable made with const must get a value right away: const {name} = …
errors.tdz: The variable "{name}" is used before it's made.
errors.notFunction: "{name}" isn't a function, it's {typeName}. You can't call it with ().
errors.nullMember: Can't get "{prop}", because the value is {value}.
errors.missingArg: {fn}() needs a value inside its parentheses.
errors.reduceEmpty: On an empty list, reduce() needs a starting value.
errors.recursion: The function called itself too many times (more than {max}). Check that it stops at some point.
errors.compareObjects: You can't compare lists or objects with {op}.
errors.mathOnObject: You can't use {op} on a list or an object.
errors.inOperator: in only works with objects, lists, Map and Set.
errors.listTooLong: The list is too long (the most is {max}).
errors.badLength: A list's length must be 0 or a positive whole number.
errors.notIterable: for…of can go through a list, a text, a Map or a Set, but this is {typeName}.
errors.destructureNull: You can't take values out of {value}.
errors.importNotFound: There's no file called "{name}". Check the file name.
errors.importCycle: The file "{name}" imports itself (an import loop).
errors.importNoExport: The file "{module}" has no export called "{name}".
errors.exportNotTopLevel: You can only write export at the top level of a file, not inside a function or a loop.
errors.internal: Something went wrong inside the game. Please tell your teacher. ({message})
warnings.plant_wrongGround: This plant ({entityName}) only grows in plowed soil. Use plow() first.
warnings.plant_occupied: Something is already growing here. Gather it first with gather().
warnings.plant_cost: You don't have enough to plant this ({entityName}). You need: {costText}.
warnings.indexOutOfRange: The list has no item number {index} (the list's length is {length}). The result is undefined.
warnings.fertilizeNothing: Humus won't do anything here: there's no growing plant and no tired soil.
warnings.harvest_green: The watermelon had grown, but it wasn't sweet yet, so it was lost. Check it with scan() and gather it when it's 80 or more.
warnings.harvest_odd: This pomegranate had an odd number of seeds, so it gave no juice and spilled one of yours. Count the seeds with scan() and gather the even ones.
warnings.harvest_tired: The soil got tired of the same plant and gave a small harvest. Next time plant something else, or give the soil some humus.
warnings.swapSideways: exchange() only moves grapes along a row: Right or Left.
warnings.harvestUnripe: This plant ({entityName}) wasn't ripe yet, so it was lost with no harvest. Check with isRipe() first.
warnings.fnNoCall: "{name}" does nothing without parentheses. To run the command, write {name}().
warnings.fnAsCondition: Without parentheses, "{name}" is always true, so this condition doesn't check anything. Write {name}().
warnings.assignInCondition: Inside a condition, = gives a value, it doesn't compare. To compare, write ==.
warnings.enumVsText: "{text}" is text, but {label} is a game value, so they're never equal. Write it without quotes, like {label}.
warnings.pondResting: This pond is resting: the fish will be back in {seconds} seconds. For more fish, dig a few more ponds and fish them in turns.
warnings.mushroomSide: A ripe mushroom is hiding to the right or to the left. Tell gather() which side to look: Right or Left.
warnings.mushroomHid: The mushroom guessed which side you'd look and ran away. It learns everything that repeats. So what can't it guess?
warnings.mazeNeedsBush: To make a maze, use the magic dust on a ripe rosehip.
warnings.mazeTooSmall: Not enough magic dust. A maze needs at least {need}.
warnings.mazeReuse: To move the treasure, you need at least {need} magic dust (as much as when you made the maze).
warnings.plant_pond: Nothing grows in a pond. To fill the pond with soil, use plow().
warnings.pondNeeded: There's no pond here. Dig one first with dig() and fill it with water.
warnings.pondNotFull: The pond isn't full yet ({water}%). Fill it with water: use(Goods.Water).
warnings.build_locked: This machine ({machineName}) isn't unlocked yet. Repair the village buildings (the "Village" button).

warnings.build_cost: You don't have enough to build {machineName}. You need: {costText}.

warnings.glass_already: This tile is already covered with glass.
warnings.glass_cost: You don't have enough for the glass. You need: {costText}.
warnings.noNote: You don't have a secret note right now. Villagers sometimes give you one for their requests.
